title: At the Hunter's Camp, the hunter's dialogue about the barrow said 'it's in the tally by the rack' (implying I still needed to read the tally marks myself), but the 'read the tally marks by the smoke rack' menu option silently disappeared before I ever selected it, and the loose-stone trick worked anyway without me ever reading the tally.
where: Hunter's Camp (Vale) / talk to hunter (the old barrow)
